data.text: Those who trust in the LORD are like Mount Zion, which cannot be shaken but remains forever.
data.titulo: Firm as Zion under the LORD’s Care

data.text: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the LORD surrounds his people, from now on and forever.
For the scepter of wickedness will not rest on the land allotted to the righteous, so that the righteous will not stretch out their hands to do wrong.
Do good, LORD, to those who are good, to those who are upright in heart.
data.titulo: Do Good to the Upright in Heart

data.text: But those who turn aside to their crooked ways, the LORD will lead away with evildoers. Peace be upon Israel!
